name: Doctor Doom

abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Oyunun en yüksek kritik direncine sahip; E1'de engellenemez olur, temas ettiğinde bonusları nötralize edip şoka çevirir. İkincil hasar ve petrify erişimi olan şampiyon kullan, yeteneklerini çok kısıtlar.
signatureAbility:
Indomitable Will
Whenever Doom Nullifies a Power Gain Buff he receives one for himself, granting 20% of his max Power over 3 seconds.
If the Opponent isn't already Shocked whenever Doom Nullifies any Buff, they have a [20 - 100]% chance to be inflicted with a Shock Debuff, dealing [1,524.3] Energy Damage over 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Doom uses a mix of electricity and sorcery in his Light and Medium Attacks causing them to deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.

abilitySections.title: Titanium Armor
content: Doom's resilient armor protects him, granting immunity to Armor Break, Armor Shatter and Shock effects.

abilitySections.title: Basic Attacks
content: If the Opponent isn't already Shocked, Medium Attacks inflict a Shock Debuff dealing [508.1] Energy Damage over 2 second(s).

While charging a Heavy Attack, if the Opponent is within striking distance and suffering from Shock their Shock effects are removed and replaced with a Passive Stun for 0.6 seconds. This can't trigger during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
Landing a Heavy Attack has a 100% chance to Stagger the Opponent for 10 seconds. When a Staggered Opponent gains a Buff, all Buffs triggered at the same time are Nullified.

abilitySections.title: Aura of Haazareth
content: The Aura of Haazareth can't trigger while Doom is suffering from a Slow or Petrify Debuff and is paused during his Special Attacks.
While active, Special Attack 1 and 2 are Unblockable and grant no Power.
Light Attacks grant no Power and steal 3% of the Opponent's current Power, gaining 200% of the Power stolen.
Contact with the Opponent has a 30% chance to Nullify up to 1 Buff.

Doom becomes Unstoppable and Stun Immune against the last hit of incoming Special 1, Special 2, and Heavy Attacks. Additionally, damage received from this hit can't exceed 5% of the Opponent's Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The Aura of Haazareth is activated for 6 seconds. This will not trigger if the Aura was already active.
The first hit of this Attack steals 10% of each full Power Bar the Opponent has and Doom gains 200% of the Power stolen, capping at a maximum of 2 Bars of Power.
The amount of Power stolen is increased by a flat +10% for each full Power Bar the Opponent has.
Each beam hit has a 100% chance to Nullify up to 1 Buff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each beam hit has a 100% chance to inflict an Incinerate Debuff, each dealing [7,113.4] Energy Damage over 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict a Passive Stun for 2 seconds.

The Aura of Haazareth is activated for 12 seconds and Doom gains a Fury Buff granting [6,605.3]Attack Rating for the duration of the Aura, max stacks 2. This will always refresh at maximum duration whether or not the Aura was already active.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Indomitable Will
content: Whenever Doom Nullifies a Power Gain Buff he receives one for himself, granting 20% of his max Power over 3 seconds.
If the Opponent isn't already Shocked whenever Doom Nullifies any Buff, they have a [20 - 100]% chance to be inflicted with a Shock Debuff, dealing [1,524.3] Energy Damage over 6 seconds.
